name: Spherical Harmonics Vector Quantization
definition: A compression technique for Gaussian Splatting Spherical Harmonics (SH) data that replaces per-splat SH coefficients with indices pointing to a shared palette of distinct SH vectors, reducing memory footprint at the cost of minor lighting artifacts.
summary: Spherical Harmonics Vector Quantization compresses 3D Gaussian Splatting by clustering SH coefficients into a shared palette, distinguishing itself by treating splats independently rather than exploiting spatial correlations.
